usedFor: Before you send to a list, BounceShield checks each address with “Verify Email Address” to protect deliverability.

bestTemplate.name: “Verify Email Address” in BounceShield
bestTemplate.why: It checks a single address before you write to it, which helps deliverability.

watchOut: “Verify Email Address” checks a single address, so a list is checked one address at a time.
